name: Haikaburi-hime no Yuuutsu
source:
There is a prestigious ceremony/festival that comes once a year where a young woman is chosen to be the “Princess” of the event. Our protagonist in this game happens to be the one and only judge, and being thus he makes the girls do many unspeakable things.

[Vague Game Description by White Masq]
translation:
每年都会举行一次著名的仪式/节日，一位年轻女子被选为活动的“公主”。我们这个游戏的主角恰好是唯一的评判者，因此他让女孩们做出了许多难以言喻的事情。

[White Masq的模糊游戏描述]
